text: Our paper on dynamic tropospheric stochastic constraints for airborne GNSS positioning and ZTD estimation has been accepted in Measurement.
MSWD is featured by ETH Space Geodesy, highlighting our physics-constrained framework for direct slant wet delay modeling.
Our paper on machine-learned mapping functions for the asymmetric troposphere is published in Journal of Geodesy.
Our machine-learned asymmetric mapping functions and openly available trained models are featured by ETH Space Geodesy.
MSWD, our hybrid machine-learning framework for slant wet delay modeling, is published in JGR: Atmospheres.
I presented MSWD, my hybrid machine-learning model for slant wet delay prediction, at EGU 2026 in Vienna.
I visited the Royal Meteorological Institute and the Royal Observatory of Belgium for an exchange on atmospheric observations and GNSS meteorology.
Our group secured Alps supercomputer resources through the Swiss AI Initiative; I contribute to the effort on Earth-system AI and atmospheric prediction.
I presented my work on machine-learned tropospheric mapping functions at the IAG Scientific Assembly 2025 in Rimini.
Our TGRS paper on assimilating ground-based and airborne GNSS delays into numerical weather predictions is featured by ETH Space Geodesy.
Our paper on assimilating ground-based and high-dynamic airborne GNSS zenith total delays into numerical weather predictions is published in IEEE TGRS.
I presented my work on assimilating airborne GNSS observations for numerical weather prediction at EGU 2024 in Vienna.
I joined the Space Geodesy group at ETH Zurich as a PhD student, focusing on GNSS meteorology, data assimilation, and machine learning for tropospheric modeling.
